declare
 temp_id VARCHAR2(10);
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select co.consignee_id into temp_id
 from customers cu, consignee co
 where co.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and cu.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and co.consignee_id = :ctrl_blk_1.consignee
 and cu.customer_id = co.customer_id
 and ((:g_reject_option in ('','ALL')
 and cu.customer_type in ('RD', 'DI','LC'))
 or
 (:g_reject_option = cu.customer_type))
 and sysdate between cu.eff_date
 and nvl(cu.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and sysdate between co.eff_date
 and nvl(co.term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 begin
 select co.consignee_id into temp_id
 from customers cu, consignee co
 where co.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and cu.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and upper(co.name) like :consignee || '%'
 and ((:g_reject_option in ('','ALL')
 and cu.customer_type in ('RD', 'DI','LC'))
 or
 (:g_reject_option = cu.customer_type))
 and sysdate between cu.eff_date
 and nvl(cu.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and sysdate between co.eff_date
 and nvl(co.term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then

 list_values;
 end;
 end;
 if temp_id is null
 then
 return;
 else
 :consignee := temp_id;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: PRODUCTS_PRODUCT_COD_LOV4
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select dp.product_code, vp.product_short_name 
from discard_products dp, vserv_products vp 
where dp.unit_id = :products.unit_id 
and dp.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id 
and substr(dp.product_code ,1,5) = vp.product_code 
and vp.unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme 
and :banner.hdr_date between vp.eff_date and nvl(vp.term_date,:banner.hdr_date+365)
and not exists
(
 select 1
 from vserv_customer_products vcp 
 where :banner.hdr_date 
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:banner.hdr_date+1) 
 AND vcp.customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_customer_id
 AND NVL(vcp.consignee_id, :ctrl_blk_1.consignee) = :ctrl_blk_1.consignee
 and (vcp.prod_type = :products.product_type
 or vcp.prod_code = vp.product_code) 
)

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_S_PROD_TYPE_LOV2

select product_type, substr(product_type_desc,1,25) 
from vserv_product_types vpt 
where :banner.hdr_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) 
and exists (
 select 1 
 from discard_products

 and product_type = vpt.product_type) 
and not exists (

 AND NVL(vcp.consignee_id, :ctrl_blk_1.consignee) = :ctrl_blk_1.consignee
 AND vcp.prod_type = vpt.product_type
 ) 
order by product_type
